id.description: Stable id: the first 8 hex digits of the sha256 of pool.iop when the pool was added. Never changes, not on rename, move or a later fix of pool.iop. Quote it in YAML.

name.description: Human readable name of the machine or pool.

manufacturer.description: Manufacturer name, as in the AgIsoVirtualTerminal ManufacturerMap for manufacturer_code.

manufacturer_code.description: ISOBUS manufacturer code from the working-set NAME. It names the maker of the ECU, which is not always the machine brand.

source.description: Free text: how and where the pool was captured.

public.description: Whether the pool may be shown in a public gallery. false unless someone has confirmed it may.

render.description: Terminal settings to render the pool with, in pixels.

known_issues.description: URLs of issues about this pool.
